items.text: We need to do more on the federal level to prevent opioid misuse & broaden access to treatment & support.

Families are finding it more difficult to find baby formula in stores. Here is some helpful information for WA parents to make sure your children get the nutrition they need to grow.  
https://t.co/dzoytifCxN

NEW: I submitted 15 community projects in WA-01 for dedicated funding consideration!

These projects span our district & include regional trail & roadway improvements, health & wellness centers, green job training, emergency services, & wastewater & sewer infrastructure projects. https://t.co/d7hf32KV7U

2 more baby formula missions are already in motion & will deliver approximately 8.3M bottles of formula to our shelves—on top of the 1.5M bottles already transported!

President Biden is alleviating this strain on families to ensure that our children get the nutrition they need.

Temperatures are going up quickly this weekend. It is important to exercise caution by staying cool & hydrated & avoiding swimming in the Pacific as waters are still very cold. https://t.co/KizeBI8OSA

This week, I voted to pass the Ensuring Women’s Right to Reproductive Freedom Act to prevent Republicans from criminalizing Americans who exercise their constitutional right to travel—or help someone travel—across state lines to obtain a lawful abortion.

Monkeypox is spreading throughout the U.S. & 150+ people in WA have tested positive for the virus. 

Know the symptoms, risks, & what to do if you’ve been exposed. More info below.

The Boys & Girls Club of Snohomish Co.’s Nespelem Club has received $7K in federal funding to support nutrition programs for youth ages 9-17. 
 
This program helps to ensure our youth have access to healthy foods & teaches them about the ways their food is grown & prepared. https://t.co/jOenuqGoWX

Since its launch in July, @988Lifeline has quickly become critical in improving America’s mental health system by expanding access to care & saving lives.
If you or a loved one need help, call/text 988.   
https://t.co/rHFSVibcJs

This National #RecoveryMonth I’m joining in #CongressGoesPurple to raise awareness & support those in recovery.

If you are struggling with a mental health or substance use disorder, don’t be afraid to ask for help. Recovery is possible.

More resources⬇️
https://t.co/fbYehj4jfr

It's unacceptable that Latina women are paid just 54 cents for every $1 white male workers make.

On #LatinaEqualPayDay, we must continue pushing for more equitable pay, treatment, & benefits in the workplace. #Trabajadoras

Beauty industry workers deserve the same tax fairness as those in other industries. 

@RepLaHood & I introduced legislation today to grant equal treatment to salon owners & beauty professionals by extending the tax tip credit to the beauty industry. https://t.co/p4xJ1phVxQ

Students shouldn’t have to worry about where they'll sleep or if they'll be able to pay rent.

I'm continuing to push & build bipartisan support for federal investments that would add 66K+ affordable homes in WA & 1.5M+ nationwide. 
https://t.co/cJV53nSET6

@RepRickLarsen & I met w/ the Post Offices’ WA District Manager to express our ongoing frustration about mail delays in NW WA & treatment of postal workers.

I will continue to demand answers & information until reliable mail service is restored in the area.

I secured $1M in federal funding for critical upgrades to Sultan’s Wastewater Treatment Plant. This investment will help improve local water infrastructure & meet the needs of the city’s growing population.

Read what Sultan Mayor Russell Wilta had to say about this effort. https://t.co/LcVeytak0Y

Federal food assistance plays a critical role in ensuring families can get the nutrition they need.

It’s time to strengthen & expand these benefits so families can keep food on the table, not pull them back or add new hoops to jump through.
https://t.co/q3YZROMGhd

After 50+ years of captivity, poor health, & her unacceptable enclosure, Tokitae is finally being freed! 

There are still many questions to answer about her treatment at Miami Seaquarium but we can all celebrate this news today. https://t.co/kpi8Wuit1W

Excited to present Friends of Youth with $1M that I secured to expand its new Willows Youth Services Center.   This investment will provide young adults with an expanded shelter & essential services, including mental & primary health care, substance use treatment, & more. https://t.co/5iEQUD8fC8

Our democracy is strongest when everyone can participate.

It’s time for Congress to pass the #FreedomToVote Act to protect our democratic process & ensure all Americans can exercise their right to vote & have their voices heard.

New research has found that the use of hearing aids can reduce cognitive decline by nearly 50%.

This is great news for the for the nearly 30M Americans experiencing mild-to-moderate hearing loss. 
https://t.co/IfvaKnMLXK

Kirkland is receiving nearly $1.3M in federal funding for a new substance use treatment program at the city jail.

This program will make a meaningful impact across our entire community, helping incarcerated people overcome addiction, rebuild their lives, & reenter society. https://t.co/6nvjJXRQbF

Medicare covers in-center & home dialysis for people w/ kidney failure but for those w/ acute kidney injury, they must get treatment in a dialysis center.

I’m pushing CMS to cover home dialysis for these Americans & potentially avoid their condition worsening. https://t.co/fgqEJuXCYY

Great to join Friends of Youth for the ribbon cutting of the Willows Youth Services Center in Kirkland!

This new facility will offer young adults an expanded shelter & access to essential services, including mental & primary health care, substance use treatment, & more. https://t.co/ZhkyZJtohe
I am deeply honored to receive a blanketing from Northwest Indian College in recognition of the $2M I secured for their new Health & Wellness Center. https://t.co/SySfNOYbvw

4 in 10 Americans know someone who died from an opioid overdose.

Congress must continue working with communities to expand access to resources & treatment to combat this public health crisis.
https://t.co/w9LE3weTaP
